fields.name: OrleansShardPersistenceOptions
fields.description: Mutable state used to select a sharded Orleans persistence provider, identify its shard set, choose whether grain keys are checked, supply query definitions, and carry its lifecycle initialization stage.

members.name: ShardSetKey
members.description: The key used both for the shard set and for the Orleans storage provider.

members.name: ValidateGrainKeys
members.description: Whether grain identity and model key matching is enabled.

members.name: Queries
members.description: A mutable lookup of the available persistence query definitions by GrainType.

members.name: InitStage
members.description: The silo lifecycle stage at which storage initialization is scheduled.
